observation.visible_scene: A vertical wooden post with a small metal hook at its top stands on a white surface against a plain light wall. Suspended from the hook is a transparent plastic cup holding a white cylindrical object. A flexible clear tube is attached to the cup and bends into a large open loop (roughly circular) that surrounds the cup; a fixed arc of this tube is colored blue. A thin wooden stick/skewer is fastened to the cup and projects outward. The whole hanging assembly is in continuous motion during the excerpt.
visible_changes: The suspended assembly rotates and tilts about the hook: comparing frame 1 (t=0) and frame 41 (t=2.667), the cup's tilt changes from opening facing upper-right to a more upright orientation, and the stick sweeps from pointing down-left to pointing up-left.

The tube loop changes apparent shape as it rotates in 3D, cycling between a wide open ellipse (e.g. frames 1-3, 26-30) and a narrower, more edge-on profile (e.g. frames 13-14, 39-41), indicating rotation about a vertical axis through the hook.

The blue arc of the tube moves around the perimeter of the loop over time (bottom in frames 1-7, right in frame 8, left in frames 12-22, bottom again in frames 28-35, left in frames 40-41), showing the tube/loop is also spinning relative to the viewpoint.
The white cylindrical object stays inside the cup throughout, shifting its apparent position within the cup as the cup tilts (e.g. lower-right in frames 1-3, more central/upright in frames 16-22).

Motion blur varies frame to frame (strong blur in frames 1, 9-12, 26-27, 38-39; sharper images in frames 4-7, 16-22, 31-35), consistent with a non-uniform rotation/oscillation speed rather than a constant rate.
The wooden post, hook, wall and table edge remain fixed in the frame, so the observed motion is object motion, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the rotation/swing of the assembly is not shown (the motion is already underway at t=0).
Whether the motion will continue, damp out, or reverse after t=2.667 is not shown.
The exact attachment details of the tube and stick to the cup are partly hidden by blur and viewing angle.
uncertain_details: It is not fully determinable whether the blue segment's travel around the loop is due to the tube spinning about the cup's axis or to the whole assembly precessing; both effects appear combined.
The precise axis and sense of rotation (clockwise vs counter-clockwise about the vertical) cannot be fixed unambiguously from these sampled frames.
The white cylinder's material and the tube's contents (if any) cannot be confirmed from appearance alone.
